description: Market data with timestamps older than 1 hour. All data points have timestamps at least 1 hour behind the reference 'now' time, simulating a data feed that has stopped updating. Tests stale-data detection, circuit breaker triggers, and fallback behavior.

expected_behavior.stale_detection: all 10 data points have timestamps > 1 hour old relative to reference_now_ms
expected_behavior.risk_system: should refuse to calculate risk metrics from stale data; return STALE_DATA error
expected_behavior.execution: should halt all order submission when latest market data is > 60 seconds old
expected_behavior.alerting: should fire STALE_MARKET_DATA alert with severity=CRITICAL
expected_behavior.fallback: should attempt reconnection to backup data feed; if unavailable, enter SAFE_MODE
